scope: Complete eleven-run development history, exact source/Git binding and independent root review only; no Quality implementation or full-repository gate.

transformation_rules.name: local_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: raw_home stripped of trailing slash, then slash

transformation_rules.name: ci_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: ci_home stripped of trailing slash, then slash

transformation_rules.name: pytest_user_root
transformation_rules.find_parameter: pytest temporary-root prefix followed by basename(raw_home)

aggregate_rule: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON of files/generated_files; sort_keys=True,separators comma/colon,ensure_ascii=False
path_rules: Patch/diff names get .log suffix; repeated original SHA aliases point to one exact public artifact.
